definitions.explanation: Frequency modulation radio broadcasting, which offers higher audio quality than AM radio.

examples.japanese: FM{放送|ほうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧FM⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I searched for an FM station in the car.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧FM⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}き→届く：00899_todoku⟧にくい。
examples.english: FM signals are hard to receive in this area.

notes:
FM stands for frequency modulation (⟦{周波数|しゅうはすう}→周波数：25041_shuuhasuu⟧{変調|へんちょう}). It offers better sound quality than AM but has shorter range.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- FM{放送|ほうそう}: FM broadcasting
- FM⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧: FM station
- FM⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧: FM program
- FM⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：01541_rajio⟧: FM radio

JAPANESE FM STATIONS:
Japan has numerous FM stations including:
- ⟦{地上波|ちじょうは}→地上波：27732_chijouha⟧FM: terrestrial FM (76.1-94.9 MHz)
- ⟦コミュニティ→コミュニティ：08426_komyuniti⟧FM: community FM stations
- J-WAVE, FM802, FM⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧ are popular stations
